high.description:
About the Company
Dar Al-Handasah (Shair and Partners) is a renowned multidisciplinary consultancy firm specializing in Architecture, Engineering, Planning, and Environmental Design. With a legacy of over 60 years, we have a global presence and a commitment to delivering innovative and sustainable solutions to our clients' most complex challenges. Our diverse team of professionals collaborates across disciplines to create iconic projects that shape cities and improve lives.


About the Role
We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled Senior Full Stack Developer with strong expertise in ReactJS, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS and TypeScript. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of designing, developing and maintaining scalable web applications and RESTful APIs. The role requires hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code and ChatGPT, integrating them into everyday engineering workflows to enhance productivity, code quality and delivery efficiency. The successful candidate will also play an important role in technical mentoring, code reviews, engineering best practices and continuous innovation within the development team.
The Senior Full Stack Developer will design, develop and maintain scalable web applications and RESTful APIs, actively leverage AI-assisted development tools in daily workflows, and provide technical leadership and mentoring while driving engineering best practices and continuous innovation.


Responsibilities
Full Stack Development 

- Design, develop and maintain scalable, modular and high-performance web applications using ReactJS, Next.js, JavaScript and TypeScript.
- Develop robust backend services and applications using Node.js and NestJS.
- Ensure application performance, reliability, scalability and maintainability.
- Write clean, reusable, efficient and well-documented code.


REST API Development & Integration 

- Design, develop, test and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services.
- Ensure seamless integration between frontend applications and backend systems.
- Implement secure, scalable and efficient data communication workflows.
- Work with relational and NoSQL databases.


AI-Augmented Engineering 

- Actively use AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code and ChatGPT in daily development activities.
- Leverage AI tools for code generation, debugging, test creation, documentation and code reviews.
- Apply effective prompt engineering techniques to generate reliable and high-quality code.
- Evaluate and introduce emerging AI tools and workflows to improve engineering productivity and code quality.


Technical Leadership & Mentoring 

- Mentor and guide junior developers on technical challenges, coding standards and best practices.
- Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to software development standards.
- Promote knowledge sharing, collaboration and continuous improvement within the team.
- Contribute to technical discussions, solution design and architectural decisions.


Collaboration & Continuous Improvement 

- Collaborate with product managers, UI/UX designers and cross-functional teams to deliver effective software solutions.
- Stay updated with emerging technologies, frameworks and software engineering practices.
- Identify opportunities to improve development processes, application performance and delivery efficiency.
- Drive innovation and technical excellence across development initiatives.


Web 3D Rendering (Desirable) 

- Contribute to projects involving web-based 3D rendering technologies, where applicable.
- Explore and apply 3D rendering concepts to enhance interactive web experiences.


 Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
- Minimum 10 years of professional experience in web application development.




Required Skills:

- ReactJS, Next.js
- JavaScript and TypeScript
- Node.js and NestJS
- RESTful APIs and backend development
- Demonstrated experience in designing and developing scalable, modular and high-performance web applications.
- Proven experience in integrating frontend and backend applications.
- Practical, daily experience using AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code or ChatGPT in professional development workflows.
- Strong understanding of software architecture, debugging, testing, code optimization and version control.
- Experience mentoring developers and conducting technical code reviews.
- Good understanding of database technologies and data management.
- Excellent problem-solving, communication and collaboration skills.
- Strong interest in continuous learning and adopting emerging technologies.


 Preferred Skills

- Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and MongoDB.
- Knowledge or experience in web-based 3D rendering technologies and frameworks.
- Experience working with modern AI-powered development workflows and automation.
- Experience in technical design, system architecture and engineering process improvements.


What We Are Looking For
A hands-on senior engineer who combines strong full-stack development capabilities with AI-driven engineering practices, takes ownership of technical delivery, and enjoys mentoring teams while building high-quality, scalable software solutions.

high.description:
About Enterprise Bot
Enterprise Bot is the leading provider of GenAI, Conversational AI, and automation software, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland. Our intelligent virtual assistants and automation tools help organizations improve efficiency, reduce costs, and deliver exceptional customer experiences across industries such as banking, insurance, and logistics. Our mission is to become the world’s #1 AI-driven automation software provider within the next five years.
We work with leading companies such as the SIX Group (Swiss Stock Exchange), SWICA, Generali, and others to enhance customer interactions and automate business processes using our cutting-edge Conversational AI technology.
Our global team includes more than 70 highly skilled professionals from diverse backgrounds.
We foster an open, progressive company culture with state-of-the-art technology and flat hierarchies. At Enterprise Bot, you’ll experience a unique blend of passion, purpose, challenge, and fun.
Your first months at Enterprise Bot
We're looking for a Full Stack Engineer with 2–4 years of experience who enjoys working across both frontend and backend and wants to build products at the intersection of software engineering and AI.
You’ll work on our AI-powered products and platforms, building everything from interactive user interfaces and dashboards to APIs, backend services, integrations, and AI-powered workflows.
This isn't a role where you'll just pick up tickets and write code.
We’re looking for someone who can take ownership of a feature end-to-end — understand the requirement, design the solution, build it, test it, and get it into production.
What You'll Do
Full Stack Development

- 
Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications across the frontend and backend.
- 
Build responsive, intuitive, and high-performance user interfaces using React and TypeScript.
- 
Develop scalable backend services and APIs using Node.js.
- 
Work across the complete product lifecycle — from technical design to development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
- 
Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and third-party services.
- 
Build reusable components and maintain clean, scalable code.


Backend & APIs

Design and develop secure and reusable RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs.
- 
Build backend services using Node.js, Express.js, Koa, or similar frameworks.
- 
Design efficient database schemas and optimise queries.
- 
Work with MongoDB and SQL databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
- 
Implement authentication and authorisation using technologies such as JWT and OAuth.
- 
Build integrations with internal and external systems.
- 
Troubleshoot production issues and improve system performance and reliability.


Frontend

Build modern web interfaces using React and TypeScript.
- 
Translate product and UI designs into high-quality, production-ready interfaces.
- 
Create reusable UI components and contribute to frontend architecture.
- 
Ensure applications are responsive, accessible, and performant.
- 
Work closely with Product and Design teams to turn ideas into intuitive user experiences.


AI & Agentic Systems
You’ll be working in an AI-first engineering environment.

- 
Integrate LLM APIs and AI capabilities into production applications.
- 
Work with AI-powered workflows and intelligent automation.
- 
Build or integrate agent-based systems and tool orchestration.
- 
Work with AI APIs, inference workflows, prompt orchestration, and model integrations.
- 
Explore new approaches to building AI-powered product experiences.
- 
Stay curious about emerging AI technologies and developer tools.


You don't need to be an AI/ML researcher. We’re looking for strong software engineers who are excited about learning and building with AI.
Quality, Performance & Reliability

- 
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.
- 
Write unit and integration tests using tools such as Jest, Mocha, or Chai.
- 
Debug issues across frontend, backend, APIs, and databases.
- 
Identify performance bottlenecks and improve application scalability.
- 
Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices.
- 
Document technical solutions, APIs, and architecture where required.


Collaboration

- 
Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, AI Engineers, QA, DevOps, and other developers.
- 
Participate in technical discussions and architecture decisions.
- 
Break down product requirements into practical technical solutions.
- 
Take ownership of features and deliver them from concept → production.
- 
Contribute to a collaborative and fast-moving engineering culture.


What we are looking for

- 
2–4 years of professional experience in full-stack software development.
- 
Strong experience with JavaScript / TypeScript.
- 
Strong backend development experience with Node.js.
- 
Good hands-on experience with React and modern frontend development.
- 
Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and/or GraphQL APIs.
- 
Strong understanding of MongoDB and experience with at least one SQL database such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
- 
Good understanding of asynchronous programming, promises, async/await, and event-driven architecture.
- 
Experience with authentication and authorisation mechanisms such as JWT and OAuth.
- 
Good understanding of software development best practices, testing, debugging, and version control.
- 
Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
- 
Ability to troubleshoot production issues and work independently.
- 
Good understanding of responsive web development.
- 
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
- 
Good communication skills and ability to work in a cross-functional team.


Good to Have

- 
Experience with AI/LLM integrations.
- 
Experience working with AI agents or agentic workflows.
- 
Experience with real-time systems or event-driven architectures.
- 
Exposure to voice technologies, streaming, speech-to-text, or text-to-speech.
- 
Experience with Redis or other caching technologies.
- 
Experience with microservices architecture.
- 
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
- 
Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
- 
Experience with CI/CD pipelines.
- 
Experience working in a SaaS or B2B product company.
- 
Exposure to AI coding assistants and AI-powered development workflows.


What We Value
At Enterprise Bot, we value ownership over titles.
We're looking for someone who:

- 
Doesn't wait for instructions for every step.
- 
Can take a problem and figure out how to solve it.
- 
Is comfortable working in a fast-changing startup environment.
- 
Cares about the quality of what they build.
- 
Is curious about AI and new technologies.
- 
Enjoys learning and experimenting.
- 
Can balance speed with good engineering practices.
- 
Is comfortable working across different parts of the technology stack.


Benefits

- 
Build products at the forefront of GenAI and Conversational AI.
- 
Work on real-world AI products used by international enterprises.
- 
Get exposure to LLMs, AI agents, automation, voice, and real-time systems.
- 
Work with a global engineering and product team.
- 
High ownership and the opportunity to make a visible impact.
- 
Flat hierarchy and an open, collaborative culture.
- 
Opportunity to learn and work with rapidly evolving AI technologies.
- 
Competitive compensation and strong opportunities for growth.


Join our team
If you're excited about building full-stack products and want to work where software engineering meets AI, we'd love to hear from you.

high.title: AI Engineer — Innovation Lab
high.description:
About the Role


The Innovation Lab applies and adapts AI to accelerate work across eGov’s spectrum of products and platform — DIGIT and the products built on it, including DIGIT HCM (Health Campaign Management). The Lab runs a continuous pipeline of experiments, taking validated problems through bounded prototypes to capabilities that eGov’s product teams can adopt. It applies foundation models and modern GenAI techniques to gov tech problems rather than building models from scratch.
The AI Engineer is a hands-on builder in the Lab. Working closely with the AI Tech Lead, the engineer turns experiment ideas into working prototypes, runs evaluations, and helps build the reusable components and harnesses that keep the Lab fast — following sound engineering discipline throughout. This is an early-career role for a fast learner who is fluent with modern AI tools and eager to grow, with depth built through pairing, code review and bounded experiments across applied AI, engineering craft and the gov tech domain.


Key Responsibilities


• Build prototypes: Turn experiment briefs into working prototypes under the direction of the AI Tech Lead — using foundation models, LLM APIs, prompting, RAG and related techniques.
• Evaluation and evidence: Help design and run evaluations of prototypes for quality, reliability and latency, and capture results, limitations and observations clearly.
• Engineering quality and SDLC: Follow a disciplined development lifecycle — version control, code review, automated testing and continuous integration — writing clean, tested, documented and reproducible code.
• Reusable components: Contribute to shared components, evaluation harnesses and starter repositories that raise the Lab’s throughput.
• Handover-readiness: Produce clear technical notes and documentation so prototypes are transferable rather than black boxes.
• Communicate and collaborate: Pair with the Tech Lead and partner engineers, present at sprint showcases, and communicate progress, results and blockers clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.


Required Skills & Experience


1. Foundations: 0–2 years of experience; freshers welcome. Strong computer-science fundamentals — data structures, algorithms and clean coding practice. A degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent demonstrable ability.
2. Applied AI (core): Hands-on experience building with LLMs and modern AI tools — through work, internships, academic, hackathon or personal projects. Familiarity with prompting, LLM APIs and at least one AI/GenAI framework. Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as part of everyday building.
3. Programming: Strong in at least one language, with Python preferred for AI work. Exposure to web or full-stack development; willingness to work across the DIGIT stack (Java, React, Flutter) is an advantage.
4. SDLC and engineering craft: Good grasp of the software development lifecycle — Git and collaborative development, code review, automated testing (unit and integration) and CI/CD basics — with care for documentation and reproducibility.
5. Communication: Strong written and verbal communication; able to explain what was built and why, and to collaborate effectively within a small team.
6. Disposition: Fast learner; curious, resourceful, and able to work with minimal supervision. Interest in public sector, development sector, global health or govtech is a plus.


Good to have
• Experience with RAG, vector stores or agentic patterns; evaluation of AI systems; cloud (AWS/Azure) and Docker; contributions to open-source projects.


Position: AI Engineer — Innovation Lab
Position Type: Full Time
Location: Bangalore
Reports to: AI Tech Lead — Innovation Lab
Department: AI & Innovation Lab
Experience: 0–2 years (freshers welcome)


About eGov Foundation & DIGIT
eGovernments (eGov) Foundation, is a pioneering tech-for-good organization that exists to drive exponential impact in public service delivery at speed & scale. We are on a mission to enhance the ease of living for citizens by improving access to essential public services. Our work involves:
• Driving digital transformation globally: with our open-source platform, DIGIT (Digital Infrastructure for Governance, Impact, and Transformation), to empower nations on their journey towards modernized public services.
• Providing strategic guidance: to countries on harnessing digital public goods (DPGs) for the effective transformation of their digital services and governance.
• Fostering dynamic networks: that accelerate the adoption of digital solutions, facilitating exponential progress and innovation within governments and communities.
Our platform, DIGIT, has already benefited over 160 million citizens and continues to expand its reach, touching the lives of over 2.5 billion people worldwide. Practice areas we work in include local governance, public health, public finance, water, sanitation and climate. Our work spans across 10 countries globally and 2,600 towns and cities across 16 states in India.
If you’re passionate about revolutionizing public service delivery and enhancing the lives of billions, we’d love for you to join our team. Whether you are in a hands-on role or supporting from behind the scenes, your contributions are vital and impactful. Join us in making a transformative difference!


Why work with us?
• Make a Large Scale Impact: Contribute to projects with the potential to drive significant societal change. Gain experience tackling diverse challenges on both national and global stages.
• Learn from the Best: Receive mentorship from leading experts and professionals within our rich ecosystem, broadening your perspectives and expertise.
• Harness Technology for Good: Be part of a team dedicated to using technology to address real-world problems and enhance the lives of citizens.
• Grow and Lead: Develop essential skills and seize remarkable opportunities to lead initiatives that shape your career, all within an environment of innovation, collaboration, and excellence.


Read more about the work of eGov Foundation:
1.  https://egov.org.in/
2. https://egov.org.in/digit/

stretch.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
stretch.description:
About The Role

We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who takes a client's problem from the first conversation to a working product in production. You will build both the front end and the back end, use AI tools as a daily part of how you work, and own the outcome rather than a ticket queue.

You will also speak with our client directly: demos, status updates, scoping, and respectful pushback when a request will not serve their goal. You will work as part of a team, on site in our Bangalore office.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you stay close to the client's problem and outcome using an AI Native approach.

What You Will Own

You own the outcome from discovery to post-launch, not a single layer of the stack.



-  Discover and scope: turn a vague client need into a clear problem statement, a success metric, and a small first release.
-  Design and build: deliver the user interface, APIs, and database for features end to end, choosing the simplest approach that works.
-  Ship and run: set up deployment (CI/CD, cloud basics), add monitoring, and fix production issues you or your team introduced.
-  Communicate with clients: run demos and status calls, write clear async updates, give honest estimates, and flag risks early.
-  Iterate on results: review usage and feedback after launch, and decide what to improve, cut, or leave alone.
-  Work with the team: review code, share what works with AI tools, and help teammates unblock their own work.
-  Protect quality and trust: write tests, review AI-generated code critically, and handle client data and secrets responsibly.

What "AI-native" means here 

AI-native means AI tools are part of how you plan, build, and check your work, and you stay accountable for every line that ships. Familiarity with a tool name is not enough.



-  You work with coding agents daily (for example Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot) and can explain how you steer them: specs, context files, task breakdown, and when you take the keyboard back.
-  You review AI output critically. You test it, read it for security and maintainability problems, and reject what does not hold up.
-  You verify, not just generate. Tests, logging, and checks come with your work, because speed without confidence is not delivery.
-  You know when not to use AI, and you can explain that choice to a client in plain language.What we are looking for Experience level matters less than how you work. We value agile, quick learners who can show real shipped work.

Technical baseline 



-  Language-agnostic engineering: you pick up new languages and frameworks quickly and choose the right tool for the problem, rather than defending a favorite stack.
-  Real strength in a few languages or frameworks (for example JavaScript or TypeScript, Python, Java, Go, or C#), shown in projects that span both the front end and back end.
-  Fundamentals that carry across stacks: web basics (HTML, CSS, HTTP), designing and consuming APIs, and data modeling with SQL databases.
-  Git, pull requests, and basic CI/CD and cloud deployment.
-  A track record of using AI tools in real projects.

How You Work



-  Communication: clear spoken and written English, comfortable on client calls, and able to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical people.
-  Ownership: you follow a problem through to resolution and raise issues before they become surprises.
-  Outcome focus: you measure your work by what changed for the user or the client, not by lines of code or tasks closed.
-  Product thinking: you ask who the user is, what problem we are solving, and how we will know it worked. You suggest simpler options and say what you would leave out.
-  Problem solving: you break down unclear problems, form hypotheses, and debug methodically instead of guessing.
-  Agility: you are comfortable with changing requirements, short cycles, and learning new tools quickly.

Nice to have 



-  Prior client-facing, consulting, or agency experience, especially with North American clients.
-  Docker, a major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and infrastructure basics.
-  Experience with testing frameworks, observability tools, and performance tuning.
-  Awareness of secure coding, privacy expectations, and common client compliance requirements

such as SOC 2.



-  Open-source contributions, technical writing, or a deployed side project you can demo.

How We Evaluate

We look at what you have built, not only how you interview. Please be ready to share your Git repositories and any deployed work.



-  Application and Git review: send a link to your repositories (GitHub, GitLab, or similar) with a short note on the project you are proudest of. We read your commit history, pull requests, tests, and README, and try the deployed demo if there is one.2. Project walkthrough: a conversation where you explain one project in depth: the problem, your

key decisions, what broke, what you would change, and how you used AI along the way.



-  Practical exercise with AI tools allowed: a short build task where we watch how you plan, direct your tools, and verify the result.
-  Client communication round: a mock client call where you present your work, answer questions, and handle a change in scope.
-  Team and values conversation: how you collaborate, take feedback, and own mistakes.

If your best work is under NDA, tell us. You can describe it in the walkthrough and show a side project in the repository review instead.

Role details 

Title : Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

Employment type : Full-time employee

Location : On site, Bangalore office (not at client sites)

Experience level : Open: we hire for agility and proven work, not

years

Team :Part of a project team, working alongside a

product or account lead

Client contact : Shared: you and the lead both speak with North

American clients

Domain : Generalist, across industries

Working-hours overlap with North America and compensation range are still to be confirmed before this is published.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Apply today.

stretch.title: Senior Software Engineer (React + Node)
stretch.description:
About Tricog
Tricog is a healthcare technology, product-based company headquartered in Bangalore. We build predictive and virtual diagnostic solutions for cardiovascular diseases, enabling clinicians to make faster, more accurate decisions that save lives.
Our software directly supports clinical decision-making. As a result, we place a strong emphasis on correctness, reliability, security, and data privacy.


Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with strong frontend expertise who can independently design, build, and deliver high-quality features across the stack. You will play a key role in shaping implementation decisions, improving engineering standards, and mentoring junior engineers.
This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy owning problems end-to-end and working closely with product, clinical, and engineering stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities
● Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end features across frontend and backend systems
● Build scalable, maintainable frontend applications using React.js
● Design and implement robust backend services and APIs using Node.js
● Own feature delivery from requirements clarification to production release
● Make thoughtful trade-offs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability
● Write clean, well-tested, and well-documented code
● Review code from peers and raise the overall quality bar
● Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, including root cause analysis
● Collaborate with product managers, designers, and clinicians to refine requirements
● Ensure adherence to security, privacy, and reliability best practices, especially for healthcare data
● Actively contribute to improving engineering processes, tooling, and standards
● Use modern developer tooling, including AI-assisted development tools, to improve productivity while maintaining high standards of code quality, reliability, and maintainability.


Required Skills & Experience
● 4–7 years of professional software engineering experience
● Strong proficiency in JavaScript and Typescript
● Strong proficiency in HTML/CSS
● Solid experience with
○ React.js and modern frontend patterns
○ Node.js and RESTful API design
● Experience working with databases
○ SQL (MySQL / PostgreSQL)
● Strong understanding of
○ Software design principles
○ Performance optimization
○ Error handling and observability
● Hands-on experience with
○ Unit and integration testing
○ Git-based workflows and code reviews
○ CI/CD pipelines
○ Any of the cloud platforms like AWS, GCP
● Ability to debug complex issues across the stack
● Clear communication and collaboration skills
● Demonstrates sound judgment in leveraging AI-assisted tools—knowing when to use them and when not to.


Nice-to-Have
● Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud-native systems
● Exposure to healthcare, medical devices, or regulated domains
● Experience designing APIs or systems consumed at scale
● Prior mentoring experience


Why Join Tricog (Senior Level)
● Own meaningful features used in real clinical workflows
● Influence technical decisions and engineering practices
● Work on systems where correctness truly matters
● Grow toward Staff/Lead roles with increasing scope and impact
